title: Communities, networks and youth groups
intro: Where young people already meet, organise and speak up: youth parliaments and assemblies, local youth councils, clubs and uniformed groups, and networks for young people whose voices are least often heard.

kinds.note: Most councils run a youth council or forum: ask your council or your MYP.

kinds.k: Clubs, uniformed groups and youth work

safety: Meeting people from an online group? Meet in public, tell a trusted adult, and use groups run by organisations with safeguarding policies.
